entries.name: Crystal Shard
entries.description: A dull fragment of resonance seam. Common as gravel beneath the mines.

entries.name: Resonant Crystal
entries.description: It hums faintly when held near ink. Scribes pay well for the clarity.

entries.name: Prismatic Crystal
entries.description: Splits lamplight into colours that have no names in the register.

entries.name: Pale Cap
entries.description: Grows thick along the garden terraces. Bitter, but it holds pigment.

entries.name: Glowspore
entries.description: Sheds a cold blue light for about an hour after picking.

entries.name: Dreamveil
entries.description: Fruits only in the hours the courtyard is empty. Nobody has watched it happen.

entries.name: Emberwood Branch
entries.description: Warm to the touch long after it is cut from the grove.

entries.name: Emberwood Heartwood
entries.description: Taken from the trunk, where the grain runs red and refuses the saw.

entries.name: Ember Core
entries.description: A knot of wood that never cooled. Groundskeeper Bram buries the ones he finds.

entries.name: Resonant Dust
entries.description: Ground crystal, fine enough to suspend in ink without clouding it.

entries.name: Azure Ink
entries.description: Holds a glyph for a century. The scribing hall accepts nothing weaker.

entries.name: Ember Ink
entries.description: Sets warm and stays warm. Reserved for cards meant to be cast in anger.

entries.name: Academy Pick
entries.description: Issued at the quartermaster's stall. Blunts quickly against resonance seams.

entries.name: Garden Sickle
entries.description: Short, curved, and kept sharp enough to take a cap without bruising it.

entries.name: Grove Axe
entries.description: Bram's design. Heavy enough for heartwood, balanced enough for a long session.
